source_boundary.original_conclusion_context: Ex9 asserts T_n >= (sum_{j=1}^n E_j)/C -> infinity, almost surely, in the nonterminating-recursion and nonzero-rate branch; C is the fixed pathwise rate bound from Ex6.
source_boundary.bounded_leaf_restated: For independent random variables E_j with common law Exp(1), j >= 1, sum_{j=1}^n E_j tends to +infinity almost surely as n tends to infinity.

objects.expectation: A family of real-valued measurable clocks carrying the actual common Exp(1) law and joint independence. A concrete canonical model may construct these facts internally.

domains.source: Clock indices n >= 1. An ambient probability space is implicit and unspecified. Waiting-time variable u >= 0 belongs to a later hazard consumer.
domains.expectation: Keep the probability measure explicit in any later formal statement. A real-valued total sample space need only agree with the source law almost everywhere; support behavior must be proved from that law.
domains.prohibited_drift: No requirement that every point of an arbitrary real-sequence carrier be a strictly positive sample path.

quantifiers.source: The family is chosen before the recursion. Divergence is almost sure as n tends to infinity.
quantifiers.expectation: A single full-measure event must support the claimed sequence limit. For an all-clock positivity claim, use one simultaneous almost-everywhere event for all countably many indices.
quantifiers.prohibited_drift: Do not replace the almost-sure limit by a pointwise limit on every sample, a mere existential witness, or only a statement for each fixed partial sum.

scopes_senses.law: Exp(1), rate one (unit mean); no law depending on y, x_tilde, beta, eta, d or the initial phase point
scopes_senses.almost_sure: with respect to the law of the entire clock family
scopes_senses.divergence: limit to +infinity of nonnormalized partial sums; a strong-law limit of normalized sums is an author-invoked intermediate, not the final leaf conclusion
scopes_senses.zero_rate: The source C=0/no-jumps branch implicitly uses strictly positive exponential thresholds. A zero threshold is null under the law but must not be silently discarded in a claim about every total sample.

constant_dependencies.leaf: Only the fixed Exp(1) law; its expectation is 1.
constant_dependencies.consumer_C: C = sqrt(eta) beta sqrt(2 Ecal) (sqrt(2 eta Ecal) + ||c_{y,x_tilde}-x_tilde||), Ecal=H_{y,x_tilde}(x_0,p_0).
constant_dependencies.scope: In the paper proof y, x_tilde and (x_0,p_0) are fixed. No uniform positive lower bound on C is asserted; C may vanish and is split off.
constant_dependencies.prohibited_drift: Do not import the deterministic geometric/rate parameters into the iid scalar leaf.

indexing_contract.paper: E_1 is the first threshold; S_{n+1} uses E_{n+1}; T_0=0; T_n has n waiting-time increments; the numerator in Ex9 is sum_{j=1}^n E_j.
indexing_contract.zero_based_option: If e : Nat -> Real is used, explicitly identify e(k)=E_{k+1}; then sum over k in range n equals the source sum over j=1,...,n.
indexing_contract.other_realization_option: A one-based coordinate realization can instead leave coordinate 0 unused. It must record the index translation rather than silently shift an actual consumer.
indexing_contract.empty_sum: n=0 gives an empty sum equal to 0; this is consistent with T_0 and does not affect the limit.

source_route_and_background.author_route: Independent Exp(1) clocks -> named strong law of large numbers -> almost-sure divergence of the scaled sum in Ex9 -> actual T_n nonaccumulation. Only the stochastic background leaf is in scope for77.
